+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+import type { DefaultError } from './types'
+
+export const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol.for(
+  '@tanstack/query-core:persisterRestoreResult',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  data: TData
+  state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+  __persisterRestoreResult?: boolean
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]?: boolean
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    ...result,
+    data: (result.data !== undefined
+      ? result.data
+      : result.state?.data) as TData,
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+    __persisterRestoreResult: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (persisterRestoreResultSymbol in value ||
+      Boolean((value as any).__persisterRestoreResult))
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  live: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  persisted: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  const persistedHasData = persisted.data !== undefined
+  const liveHasData = live.data !== undefined
+
+  const liveDataUpdatedAt = live.dataUpdatedAt
+  const persistedDataUpdatedAt = persisted.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  // 1. Data freshness
+  const usePersistedData =
+    persistedHasData &&
+    (!liveHasData || persistedDataUpdatedAt > liveDataUpdatedAt)
+
+  const data = usePersistedData ? persisted.data : live.data
+  const dataUpdatedAt = usePersistedData
+    ? persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    : liveDataUpdatedAt
+  const dataUpdateCount = usePersistedData
+    ? (persisted.dataUpdateCount ?? live.dataUpdateCount)
+    : live.dataUpdateCount
+
+  // 2. Error freshness
+  const persistedHasError = persisted.error != null
+  const liveHasError = live.error != null
+
+  const liveErrorUpdatedAt = live.errorUpdatedAt
+  const persistedErrorUpdatedAt = persisted.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  const usePersistedError =
+    persistedHasError &&
+    (!liveHasError || persistedErrorUpdatedAt > liveErrorUpdatedAt)
+
+  const keepLiveError =
+    liveHasError &&
+    (!persistedHasError || liveErrorUpdatedAt >= persistedErrorUpdatedAt)
+
+  let error: TError | null = null
+  let errorUpdatedAt = 0
+  let errorUpdateCount = live.errorUpdateCount
+  let fetchFailureCount = 0
+  let fetchFailureReason: TError | null = null
+
+  if (usePersistedError) {
+    error = persisted.error as TError
+    errorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = persisted.errorUpdateCount ?? live.errorUpdateCount
+    fetchFailureCount = persisted.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    fetchFailureReason = (persisted.fetchFailureReason ??
+      persisted.error) as TError | null
+  } else if (keepLiveError) {
+    error = live.error
+    errorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = live.errorUpdateCount
+    fetchFailureCount = live.fetchFailureCount
+    fetchFailureReason = live.fetchFailureReason
+  } else {
+    error = null
+    errorUpdatedAt = Math.max(liveErrorUpdatedAt, persistedErrorUpdatedAt)
+    errorUpdateCount = Math.max(
+      live.errorUpdateCount,
+      persisted.errorUpdateCount ?? 0,
+    )
+    fetchFailureCount = 0
+    fetchFailureReason = null
+  }
+
+  // 3. Status
+  let status: 'pending' | 'success' | 'error'
+  if (error != null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = persisted.status ?? live.status
+  }
+
+  // 4. Invalidation
+  const isInvalidated = Boolean(live.isInvalidated || persisted.isInvalidated)
+
+  return {
+    ...live,
+    data,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    error,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    isInvalidated,
+    fetchMeta: usePersistedError
+      ? (persisted.fetchMeta ?? live.fetchMeta)
+      : live.fetchMeta,
+  }
+}
